Serene Cambodia Suite Escape Overlooking Mekong River

Phnom Penh, Cambodia

Wake to stunning Mekong River views from The Balé Phnom Penh by LifestyleRetreats, a gorgeous all-suite retreat in Cambodia’s capital, awarded the 2021 Tripadvisor Travellers Choice award. Take in breathtaking views from the 30-metre swimming pool alongside the river and arrive in style as you walk across a pink sandstone walkway across a black-bottomed infinity pond into this serene haven. Spend a night dining at the resort’s Theato restaurant, where you're spoilt for choice with delicious local dishes like Mekong River lobster and rice noodles, rice porridge, and water buffalo skewers. Back in your private, high-end suite - one of just 18 - relax in the outdoor living space, soak in the bathtub and then lay your head on a sumptuous, floating king bed. The Balé Phnom Penh by LifestyleRetreats is set in a peaceful pocket of Phnom Penh, about a thirty-minute drive to some of the city’s major sites including the Royal Palace and the Silver Pagoda.
